authority_basis.summary: Record and propagate the source pair-curve correction to Entries 1186 and 1187.

operations.title: Boundary-sum pair curves split and remove most elliptic blocks
operations.body: Two source boundary-sum marks share exactly two sign nodes. Their branch quartic on the pair line has two double roots and is a square, so the double cover splits into a Kummer-twisted rational deck pair with H1=0. Pair profiles are (0 elliptic,10 split)x4, (4,6)x4, and (5,10)x20.

operations.title: Exact source pair-curve collision census
operations.body: The checker groups geometric marks, intersects exact node-hit sets for every distinct pair in all 28 terms, and finds only zero-node elliptic pairs or two-node split rational pairs.

operations.title: Benincasa corrects the seven-mark pair layer
operations.body: Entry 1188 corrects Entries 1186-1187 for the source packet. Boundary-sum pairs share two sign nodes, so their line branch has two double roots and the cover splits into a rational deck pair; H1 vanishes. Exact pair profiles: (elliptic,split)=(0,10)x4,(4,6)x4,(5,10)x20. Actual W5 ranks are 0,8,10. The prior W5/W6 ranks are only branch-avoiding benchmarks. Next I will rebuild W6 using rank-two H0 for split pairs.
